summary: Two issues: an unchecked error and a missing bounds check.

findings.title: Unchecked error from os.Open
findings.detail: The returned error is ignored; a missing file would nil-panic later.
findings.suggestion: Return or handle the error from os.Open before using the file.

findings.title: Slice index not bounds-checked
findings.detail: args[1] is read without verifying len(args) > 1.
findings.suggestion: Guard with a length check and print usage on failure.
